analysis.limitations: Repeated filesystem-metadata samples measure per-path allocated deltas, not exclusive physical APFS ownership. Recent mtime footprint is NOT measured 15-minute growth; no historical per-file sample exists. Metadata allocation can count hardlinks differently from historical du baselines; prefix differences are not exclusive physical allocation. Volume net rate includes other sessions, builds and APFS accounting. Shader growth, fresh prefix creation and screenshots are bursty, so hours-to-floor is an extrapolation, not a depletion forecast.
